trigger: FAQ Q4 states that the three prompt correction values are hidden and must be learned from feedback
objective: identify the best prompt ID from public communication returns before allocating the remaining persuasion budget

estimator.identification: within-node prompt ordering cancels the node-specific multiplicative response factor
estimator.verification: require the same unique best prompt on two complete probe nodes; otherwise fall back to prompt 1
estimator.ties: no calibrated winner when normalized values tie within 1e-9

probe_policy.node_requirements: publicly scanned, alive, comm_left=3, peace or neutral persona, opinion strictly inside [-60,60]
probe_policy.ranking: lowest initial public degree, then largest distance from opinion bounds, then node ID
probe_policy.reason: avoid nodes likely to be shielded and limit the terminal cost of testing a weak or negative prompt

safety.clipping: observations ending at either opinion bound are censored and cannot rank a prompt
safety.zero_or_negative: finite zero and negative deltas are valid ordering evidence
safety.failed_action: do not record or advance a prompt after an unsuccessful environment return
safety.state: ledger receives only node ID, prompt ID, public turn, before_w and returned new_w; it cannot access seed prompts or response factors
safety.fallback: missing, conflicting, tied or censored calibration keeps prompt 1

development.seeds: six previously consumed legacy family repetition-1 graphs
metrics: probe budget and successful action count
selected public node IDs and normalized observations
terminal score of using calibrated best versus fixed prompt 1 after equal probe actions

decision: zero illegal or failed probe actions
calibrated ID must equal the true unique best in every uncensored case
do not open a new holdout, modify production, or infer an official score
